instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First day in accounts, and I've reconciled this invoice. Keep this drawer for reconciled items, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's filing. Reconciliation means matching it to our records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then label the drawer 'filed'. I'll reconcile it against this quote.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an estimate. You need the purchase order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Purchase order, then. Put that beside the invoice and take the estimate away. We can't reconcile properly with you mixing the documents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your newest club member, I second the minutes. Please record that before moving on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then record me seconding your motion. Unanimously. Please finish one item before opening the next.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask Ruth. We can't record unanimity until you've completed the vote; please don't leave me correcting the minutes at my first meeting.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your picnic rota has the names, but mine has committee approval. Put yours behind it, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Delivery isn't authorization. Please show me who approved your sandwich requests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very well. Label it 'Appendix to approved rota'. My signature goes on the front sheet; don't detach yours once I've signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the ceremony, copy my bow. I'm using the founder's diagram in the constitution.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A request isn't an amendment. Please check the printed diagram before changing the ceremony.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's signed my programme: 'Please wave.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that programme with you, then. You're performing under a personal exception. I'll bow; please stand beside me so everyone can distinguish the two.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fourth inspection for our climbing wall. Good. Add it to the opening notice, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That delays us another month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A protected month. Please don't advertise uninspected climbing as something customers have lost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll miss the whole summer. I have to offer refunds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'full summer safety closure' on them. Every refund is one customer we've protected from an unchecked climb; please include that before the amount.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two signatures on each school-trip form. Good. Check that they come from different people, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. We'll have to wait for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave the forms pending. Please don't count the waiting time as a delay; that's our independent check working.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She wants someone else to check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's right. List her as author, not checker. We've caught a gap already; leave her signature box blank until an independent checker arrives.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're delighted you're staying. I'll show you the guest room; food stays downstairs, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. After nine, though; downstairs doesn't mean the kitchen is open all morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. But taking breakfast away isn't the same as eating downstairs. Let's check the later trains together; I'll help you find one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to the swimming club. You can observe an induction before joining one; I'll explain the order as we go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. I'll stand by the pool and watch today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The gallery, please. Poolside is for inducted members. It's easy to mix them up on your first visit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could you bring me through just this once?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd be delighted to show you round after induction. Today we'll read the brochure together; please start with access, not swimming times.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I reassure you about the wedding, specify what you need guaranteed. I'll write it down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That it'll be okay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Weather, marriage or catering? Please choose one; I can't approve 'it'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need a hug until I stop shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Immediate physical reassurance, then. I'll approve that. Come here; we'll review whether you've stopped shaking before I let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow my umbrella once we've completed this loan slip. Return time first, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: When the rain stops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a condition, not a time. Put six o'clock; if it's still raining, request an extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm getting soaked while I fill this in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold it over you while you sign. Bring the slip closer, please; it's the signature we need to keep dry.
